logline: Learning from his mother that Rupert and Catherine framed Juliana for witchcraft and sentenced her to death right after their upcoming wedding, Alexander vows to return from the dead and reclaim everything stolen from him.
continuity_notes: Picking up immediately from the revelation in Episode 35 that the men ruling Ashwood orchestrated Alexander's ambush, Alexander learns of Juliana's imprisonment and looming execution.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot across the weathered wooden table lit by the warm glow of an oil lantern, framing Alexander and his mother leaning inward in the dimly lit cabin.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander's mother leans forward with both hands on the rustic table, searching her son's scarred face in disbelief.

segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Whispering, Distraught)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
segments.text: Then why did they never find you?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Alexander, his dark combat scar prominent as his eyes burn with steady, cold intensity.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Cold, Bitter)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Because they made certain no one would look.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up on Alexander's mother, her hood framing her pale, weathered face as shock deepens across her features.

segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Trembling)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
segments.text: Who?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Side profile shot of Alexander gazing toward the open doorway before slowly turning back to face his mother directly.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Grave, Sinister)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Sterling... and Rupert.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up on Alexander's mother as her breath hitches and her eyes widen in pure horror.

segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Gasping, Stricken)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
segments.text: Rupert?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot of the wooden cabin interior. Alexander stands upright opposite his mother across the lantern-lit map.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Stern, Resolute)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: They knew where I was.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Alexander leaning over the table, his eyes locked onto his mother as suppressed rage surfaces.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Fierce)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: My position was leaked to the French... before I could expose what I had discovered.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Alexander's mother clutching the collar of her dark cloak, her chest heaving with agony.

segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Horrified)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
segments.text: They gave you to the enemy?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Alexander straightening his posture, his jaw set hard.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Deadpan, Resolute)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: They gave them my location.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up on Alexander's eyes and scarred cheek, teeth bared in contempt.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Spitting with Contempt)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: They wanted the investigation buried.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Alexander's mother leaning over the map, her voice cracking.

segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Shattered)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
segments.text: And when you disappeared...?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Alexander, his voice low and cutting.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Cold)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: They declared me dead.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot from the side of the wooden table as his mother brings both hands up to cover her mouth in overwhelmed grief.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (O.S.) (Grave)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: They falsified what remained of the reports.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander's mother presses her trembling hands against her lips, tears brimming in her eyes.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up on his mother weeping openly, her ring catching the warm lamplight as she lowers her hand to her heart.

segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Tearful, Bitter)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
segments.text: And Rupert took Ashbourne.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up on Alexander's piercing blue-grey eyes, unwavering and hardened by years of exile.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Darkly)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: While the world mourned a dead heir.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on his mother's sorrowful gaze lifting toward him.

segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Choked with Tears)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
segments.text: And I mourned you.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Alexander looking down, his harsh features softening momentarily with sorrow.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Softly)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: I know.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up on his mother bowing her head toward the rustic tabletop, weeping in utter despair.

segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Sobbing)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
segments.text: I trusted them.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot as Alexander stands tall beside the weeping mother seated at the table.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Gentle yet Firm)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: You trusted family.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Profile close-up of Alexander stepping closer to the door, staring out into the falling snow.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Resentful)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: They used that trust against you.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Alexander steps back toward the table, leaning in urgently toward his mother.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Urgent, Anxious)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Mother... Juliana...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up on Alexander leaning both hands on the table, desperate for answers.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Intense)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: She went into Ashbourne Manor to save you. She never came back.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up on Alexander's strained, furrowed brow.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Tremulous)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: I thought perhaps she stayed with you.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of his mother looking up at him, agony and hesitation washing over her face.

segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Hesitant, Trembling)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
segments.text: Alexander...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Quick push-in close-up on Alexander, his eyes snapping open in sudden panic.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Alarmed)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: What?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on his mother, tears shining in the amber lamplight.

segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Choked)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
segments.text: She did come to me.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot as Alexander bends over the table, crowding his mother with fierce desperation.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Demanding)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Is she still at Ashbourne?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Alexander's mother shutting her eyes and weeping, shaking her head in deep anguish.

segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Sobbing)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
segments.text: No...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot as Alexander towers over her, his breathing turning ragged.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Desperate)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Then where is she?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up on Alexander's mother crying out in wretched guilt and horror.

segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Wailing)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
segments.text: They arrested her!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Alexander, his expression freezing in complete shock.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Stunned)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Arrested?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up as his mother clutches Alexander's forearms with desperate, pleading hands.

segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Despairing)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
segments.text: Rupert and Catherine accused her of poisoning me!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Alexander, absolute fury erupting across his scarred face.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Shouting, Incredulous)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: But she saved you!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on his mother, clutching her chest in grief.

segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Weeping)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
segments.text: I told them!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Alexander clenching his fists at his sides, trembling with rage.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Furious)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: You told them the truth!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on his mother as she cries out, devastated by the memory of the kangaroo court.

segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Agonized)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
segments.text: They called her a witch!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Frontal medium shot of Alexander standing frozen, the weight of the realization crashing down on him.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Horrified)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Juliana... is in a cell?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of his mother clutching her temple, reeling in remembered trauma.

segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Weak, Trembling)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
segments.text: She was taken before a magistrate.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight shot of Alexander, his eyes wild with terror for his wife.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Barking)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: And?!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on his mother breaking down into inconsolable sobs.

segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Weeping)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
segments.text: They condemned her.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (O.S.) (Gasping)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: No.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on his mother looking up through her tears, delivering the horrifying reality.

segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Solemn, Shattered)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
segments.text: She is to be executed.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot of the cabin as Alexander stands stiff as iron, stunned by the looming death sentence.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Guttural, Demanding)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: When?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on his mother, her hand clutched tightly against her throat.

segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Trembling)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
segments.text: After the wedding.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Alexander, narrowing his eyes in lethal suspicion.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Cold, Menacing)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: What wedding?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Profile close-up of his mother looking at him across the lantern light.

segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Grim)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
segments.text: Rupert... and Catherine's.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: A sudden dramatic metallic swell underscores the impending deadline.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Frontal close-up on his mother, solemn and resolute in her warning.

segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Deadly Serious)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
segments.text: Two days from now.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Profile shot of Alexander as dark realization settles over his face, turning to a grim, predatory glare.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Simmering with Fury)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: They are marrying in two days...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight, terrifying close-up on Alexander's eyes flashing with murderous wrath.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Deadly, Throaty)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: ...and killing my wife afterward.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot as his mother urgently grabs Alexander's coat, pleading with him.

segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Pleading, Terrified)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
segments.text: Alexander, you cannot go back there alone!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Alexander, towering over her, immovable and consumed by purpose.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Grave, Seething)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: They already took my name.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Alexander stepping forward, his voice rising with lethal thunder.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Roaring with Conviction)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: They stole my home!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up on his furious, bared teeth and wild eyes.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Venomous)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: And now they have taken Juliana!

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Close-up of Alexander's gloved hand clenching into a tight, leather-creaking fist.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: The sharp, taut creak of leather straining under monstrous grip strength.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tracking shot following Alexander as he turns his back on the warmth of the cabin and walks boldly toward the open double barn doors.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander stands framed in the doorway, staring out into the vast, snow-covered pine forest under the cold moonlight.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Calm, Chilling)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Two days.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot from inside the cabin, showing his mother clutching her chest, looking after Alexander's imposing silhouette standing at the threshold of the blizzard.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Vow of Vengeance)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Then they have two days to celebrate.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Side profile close-up on Alexander as his breath fogs into the icy winter night air, his jaw clenched tight.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Low, Menacing Promise)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Because before that wedding begins...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight side profile close-up of Alexander's battle-scarred cheek and burning gaze as he makes his final declaration.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Cold, Thunderous Finale)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: ...their dead Duke is coming home.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander stares resolutely ahead into the dark, snowy woods as the camera holds on his grim, determined expression before cutting to black.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: A heavy, ominous orchestral swell builds to a thunderous cliffhanger sting and reverberates into silence.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Barking)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: And?!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on his mother breaking down into inconsolable sobs.

segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Weeping)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
segments.text: They condemned her.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (O.S.) (Gasping)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: No.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on his mother looking up through her tears, delivering the horrifying reality.

segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Solemn, Shattered)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
segments.text: She is to be executed.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot of the cabin as Alexander stands stiff as iron, stunned by the looming death sentence.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Guttural, Demanding)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: When?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on his mother, her hand clutched tightly against her throat.

segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Trembling)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
segments.text: After the wedding.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Alexander, narrowing his eyes in lethal suspicion.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Cold, Menacing)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: What wedding?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Profile close-up of his mother looking at him across the lantern light.

segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Grim)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
segments.text: Rupert... and Catherine's.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: A sudden dramatic metallic swell underscores the impending deadline.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Frontal close-up on his mother, solemn and resolute in her warning.

segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Deadly Serious)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
segments.text: Two days from now.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Profile shot of Alexander as dark realization settles over his face, turning to a grim, predatory glare.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Simmering with Fury)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: They are marrying in two days...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight, terrifying close-up on Alexander's eyes flashing with murderous wrath.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Deadly, Throaty)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: ...and killing my wife afterward.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot as his mother urgently grabs Alexander's coat, pleading with him.

segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Pleading, Terrified)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
segments.text: Alexander, you cannot go back there alone!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Alexander, towering over her, immovable and consumed by purpose.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Grave, Seething)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: They already took my name.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Alexander stepping forward, his voice rising with lethal thunder.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Roaring with Conviction)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: They stole my home!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up on his furious, bared teeth and wild eyes.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Venomous)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: And now they have taken Juliana!

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Close-up of Alexander's gloved hand clenching into a tight, leather-creaking fist.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: The sharp, taut creak of leather straining under monstrous grip strength.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tracking shot following Alexander as he turns his back on the warmth of the cabin and walks boldly toward the open double barn doors.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander stands framed in the doorway, staring out into the vast, snow-covered pine forest under the cold moonlight.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Calm, Chilling)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Two days.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot from inside the cabin, showing his mother clutching her chest, looking after Alexander's imposing silhouette standing at the threshold of the blizzard.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Vow of Vengeance)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Then they have two days to celebrate.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Side profile close-up on Alexander as his breath fogs into the icy winter night air, his jaw clenched tight.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Low, Menacing Promise)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Because before that wedding begins...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight side profile close-up of Alexander's battle-scarred cheek and burning gaze as he makes his final declaration.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Cold, Thunderous Finale)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: ...their dead Duke is coming home.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander stares resolutely ahead into the dark, snowy woods as the camera holds on his grim, determined expression before cutting to black.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: A heavy, ominous orchestral swell builds to a thunderous cliffhanger sting and reverberates into silence.
